stories.title: Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments
stories.explanation: Microsoft plans to scale its Azure Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments starting in 2027, making it the primary inference system for Microsoft products and services. Azure Maia 200 is already in production, supporting Microsoft Copilot and next-generation model development.

stories.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
stories.explanation: NVIDIA RTX Spark is launching on October 16, combining gaming, creative, and personal AI supercomputer capabilities with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. This reinvents the PC with powerful local AI agents and a full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies.

stories.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
stories.explanation: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier models, which are larger and more capable. These models achieve comparable benchmark scores to leading models and represent a significant step in Meta's AI scaling.

stories.title: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide
stories.explanation: NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions at the OCP Global Summit to help scale AI factories worldwide, including contributing Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to OCP. This aims to create a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
stories.explanation: Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and will sell some assets to Disney for $20 million, along with a non-exclusive perpetual license for its technology. This follows lawsuits and struggles to scale its platform, which allows users to create and converse with AI characters.

stories.title: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
stories.explanation: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 in-house AI chip, designed to be the primary AI inference system for its products and services. This aims to improve cost and efficiency for AI workloads and reduce reliance on external GPUs.

stories.title: OCP Summit 2026: Powering AI with Open Innovations in Scale-Up, Scale-Out, and Scale-Across Networks
stories.explanation: Meta is sharing its next generation of open networking infrastructure at OCP Summit 2026, including its first liquid-cooled network rack (IcePack) and 102.4T switch. These innovations support Meta's latest AI workloads and models like Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, and Muse.

stories.title: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
stories.explanation: SpaceX Super Intelligence (SpaceXSI) has launched 'The X Subscription,' bundling X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one offering. This aims to attract more subscribers by providing access to AI-powered chat, coding, and premium X features.

stories.title: Apple launches HomeView, its first smart display for the home
stories.explanation: Apple has launched HomeView, its first smart display for the home, featuring a screen atop a speaker base with Siri AI voice assistant. The device focuses on displaying photos, providing information, and taking video calls, with an emphasis on design and privacy features.

stories.title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
stories.explanation: Epic Games is reportedly shifting to an 'AI first' game development model, using AI to write code and guide artwork for an upcoming Marvel/Star Wars shooter. This signifies a major pivot in game development strategy, potentially delaying the project.
